name: EventsPage - Several Recent Events
description: The events body once a busy season is behind us: several past events are recent enough to show as cards, so the Past events grid fills out instead of holding a single card. Under it, the outlined View all past events on Luma button and then the past-webinars line, both centred. The sample events have no covers, so every card shows the H-mark stand-in in its square. It is the counterpart to the one-card and no-events states.
